name: Riot Games (VALORANT, League of Legends)
notes: Riot Vanguard is a Windows kernel driver. No compatibility layer can load it, and trying risks an account flag. League of Legends has a native macOS client.

name: Fortnite
notes: Epic doesn't allow its anti-cheat to run under Wine or Proton. Play through Xbox Cloud Gaming or GeForce NOW in Safari instead.

name: Destiny 2
notes: Bungie blocks Destiny 2 on compatibility layers (BattlEye), and has banned accounts for it. Cloud gaming works.

name: Apex Legends
notes: EA turned off compatibility-layer support for Apex's Easy Anti-Cheat in late 2024.

name: Call of Duty (Ricochet)
notes: Ricochet anti-cheat uses a Windows kernel driver.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
notes: Rockstar added BattlEye to GTA Online in 2024 and blocks it on compatibility layers. Story mode may still work. Not yet verified on Isthmus.
